data.title: Offer to extend fixed-term contract into a permanent position
data.summary: Beispiel Pflegeheim am Park gGmbH offers to continue Tarek Beispiel's fixed-term employment as a Pflegefachkraft — which ends on 30 June 2027 — as an indefinite, full-time contract from 1 July 2027, on unchanged conditions. They ask for his decision within 6 working days of the letter's date.
data.explanation: Your employer offers to turn your current fixed-term job into a permanent, full-time position from 1 July 2027, with the same conditions as now. You need to let them know your decision by the deadline shown, which is counted in working days (Werktage, Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays) starting from the date of this letter. If you don't reply by then, they say they will plan the position with someone else instead. Take some time to review whether the unchanged conditions still work for you, and reply in writing so you have a record of your acceptance or refusal.

items.title: Respond to the offer to make your job permanent
items.action: Tell your employer whether you accept their offer to continue your employment as a Pflegefachkraft on an indefinite (unbefristet), full-time contract from 1 July 2027 under the same conditions
items.consequence: If you don't respond in time, the employer will plan to fill the position with someone else
